gui.export.information: A feature o' Tails be t' ability t' allow other players t' see yer tail even if t' haven doesn't have t' mod installed (Ye other shipmates still needs Tails installed though). For this, some unused pixels in ye skin be used instead t' store information about yer tail. Ye can use t' options below t' choose where t' export or whether t' upload it straight t' Minecraft skin haven. Hover over t' buttons t' see t' file locations.
